title: Enforce master branch protection / ruleset
acceptance_criteria: Direct pushes to master are rejected by GitHub before they mutate the branch
Normal pull-request merge commits remain permitted
Required CI checks must pass before master integration
validation_commands: Verify repository ruleset/branch protection through GitHub administration
Attempt a non-destructive test branch workflow and confirm master requires PR integration

human_gate.question: Enable a GitHub master branch protection/ruleset that blocks direct pushes and requires PR-based integration with required CI checks?

notes: Observed direct master push baf1bb6fb61df396c4922d7c1cfae85f838bdd14 after verified PR #33 merge. CI can detect this policy violation but cannot prevent the mutation while repository protection is disabled.
The connected GitHub execution surface does not expose repository administration writes, so this is intentionally the only critical human/admin gate created by the fabric bootstrap.
No product implementation is blocked by this task; autonomous agents continue on non-overlapping branches and use the single integration PR discipline.
